newsitem.title: UK: Hamlet warns on year profit, shares drop.
newsitem.headline: Hamlet warns on year profit, shares drop.

text.p: British clothing supplier Hamlet Group Plc said on Thursday its pretax profit for the year to June 30 would be "very substantially" below market expectations.
Hamlet's shares sank more than 40 percent on the news, dropping 29p to 42.5p to rank the company as the top percentage loser on the London stock exchange at 0735 GMT.
Hamlet blamed the shortfall on one-off costs to eliminate poor-quality customer accounts and dispose of stocks, as well as the impact of sterling's strength.
The company said its forward sales were now fully hedged to minimise further exposure to currency changes.

"Hamlet's core business remains strong and, with the elimination of the above problems, should provide a sound platform for recovery," the firm said in a statement. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
